detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Music
detail.summary: This research journal documents the activation of proj-music-003 to address predictive processing in music cognition. We are synthesizing existing source material regarding music-induced emotion and the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis to formalize how rhythmic and harmonic prediction errors correlate with emotional experience. This work aligns with the active 'music_experience' topic, prioritizing synthesis over deferred topics like information survival.

detail.title: Predictive Processing and Emotional Valence in Musical Experience
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes evidence on how music-induced emotions act as 'controlled hallucinations' and how beat perception relies on action simulation, bridging cognitive predictive processing with aesthetic experience.
